title: [spec-gap][R-X509-011/013/029/030/031/037/044] CA issuance conventions: DN rules, notBefore truncation, validity bounds, same-day + key-retirement rules
description: spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md sections 3 and 6: subject SHOULD be empty, else a single serialNumber attribute (13-char Crockford Base32 short address or 16-char uppercase hex IID); issuer MUST contain CN and SHOULD contain O; notBefore MUST be truncated to 00:00:00 UTC of issuance day; notAfter MUST be finite; validity longer than 825 days MUST NOT be issued (RECOMMENDED 200 days); a same-day replacement MUST wait for the next UTC day or use a fresher out-of-band channel (accept-on-tie is not permitted); a compromised key MUST be retired out-of-band, supersession cannot revoke it. Classification: not-implemented. Suggested placement: CA/provisioning tool (PoP bead site) for issuance defaults; verifier cache policy (freshness bead) for the displacement rules.
